questions.question: The diff review (diff-review-report.md) found only low-severity polish items. Which improvements should I apply?

options.label: Drop delay-200 (rec.)
options.description: Item 1: change the hint's class from `fade-in-up delay-200` to just `fade-in-up`. The delay only staggers the page's initial entrance; the hint appears alone after 4s, so the 200ms lag is meaningless here. Recommended.

options.label: Fold into state object
options.description: Item 2: merge isExtendedWait into the GoogleAuthState object instead of a separate useState. I recommend skipping — it entangles UI timing with the auth machine for no real gain.

options.label: Explicit text-center
options.description: Item 3: add an explicit `text-center` class to the hint instead of relying on inheritance. I recommend skipping — redundant noise.
